### Get wordpress posts

Turn off return all if you're running into issues.

## Existing WordPress categories

Set Category Taxonomy to a JSON array of real existing category IDs and names before running. The default [] fails validation. All titles are classified before any update; one invalid classification stops the whole write phase. Each update replaces the existing category list with exactly one configured ID. Source model default is made explicit as current gpt-5-mini; native model transport allows two additional transient retries. No workflow-level retries. OpenAI lists December 11, 2026 as its shutdown date: select and recheck an available model in both formats before that date. https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/deprecations/ Review your taxonomy and keep the site stable while listing pages. See README.
